# mistershell_file_catalog (Data Source)

Reads MisterShell file_catalog through the authenticated API. Permissions and scope are enforced by the server.

Requires MisterShell >= 2.1.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_file_catalog" "example" {
  location_id = 2
  parent_path = "runbooks"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_id` (Number) Location ID.

### Optional

- `parent_path` (String) Folder path; omitted means root.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Dynamic) All directly contained catalog nodes, including child-location navigation nodes; does not recurse.
- `id` (String) Catalog identity.

## Listing behavior

The lookup reads every page of one directory, without recursing. An empty
`parent_path` selects the location root. Root listings can include navigation
nodes with `node_type = "location"`, `location_id`, and `name`. File and folder
nodes carry `node_type` equal to `file` or `folder`, plus the entry fields below.
A visible ancestor without operational file-read access returns navigation
locations only; an empty listing alone does not prove that no files exist.

## Entry metadata

| Field | Type and meaning |
|---|---|
| `id`, `location_id` | Integer entry identity and containing location |
| `name`, `path` | Name and full relative catalog path |
| `kind` | `file` or `folder` |
| `size` | File size in bytes; null for folders |
| `sha256` | Hexadecimal SHA-256 checksum; null for folders |
| `content_type` | Recorded MIME type, or null |
| `uploaded_by` | Uploader identity, or null |
| `created_at`, `updated_at` | Server timestamps |

Requires `app.files.read` on the location. Resource management also requires
`app.files.write` and `app.files.delete` on that location. A visible ancestor
location is navigation only: it does not grant file access. When an entry is not
visible, managed resources retain state and report an error because the API
cannot distinguish deletion from lost scope. Restore permission, or confirm the
entry was deleted and use `terraform state rm` before recreating it.
